> SkySentinel is a low-cost AI-powered sky monitoring system that uses a wireless camera to detect and track objects in the sky. The camera streams footage to a computer, where computer vision and machine learning analyze the object's movement and appearance to classify it as a bird, aircraft, drone, or unknown object. The project explores how affordable hardware and AI can be combined to create an accessible aerial-object monitoring system.
